title: erysimum holboellii
intro: Erysimum holboellii, commonly known as Boething's Rockcress, is a flowering plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Erysimum holboellii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents of the plant include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
